title: The equivalence of solutions to fractional and logarithmic Helmholtz equations
summary: We show the following equivalence of solutions to general fractional Helmholtz equations: $u$ is a solution to $$A^su=λ^su$$ for \textit{some} fixed $0 0$ if and only if $u$ is a solution to the same equation for \textit{all} $s\neq0$. Furthermore, we show as well that $u$ equivalently solves the logarithmic Helmholtz equation $$\log(A)u=(\logλ)u.$$ Here, $A$ is a nonnegative, linear operator on a Banach space $X$.
